columns_never_fillable.reason: EMA model — under the Entrusted Management Agreement the Group receives EMA rental income (fixed + variable) and the Entrusted Manager bears ALL property operating expenses. There is no property-opex line in the audited Statement of Total Return, so a conventional per-property NPI is not disclosed. Per-property EMA rental income IS disclosed (SGD '000) in Note 23 Operating Segments (p198) and is stored as net_property_income = gross_revenue.

Per-property revenue is disclosed only as EMA rental income. The audited per-property figure (Note 23 Operating Segments, SGD '000) is used; per-property outlet sales (RMB) is an operational metric, not audited SGD gross revenue, and is kept in the _recovery_note.
Cards disclose Gross Floor Area (GFA) and Net Lettable Area (NLA), not a separate 'gross lettable area' (GLA). GFA -> gfa, NLA -> nla; gla left null.

The audited Statement of Portfolio (p163) has only Valuation columns (RMB'000 and S$'000). Per-property 'Acquired value' is disclosed on the property cards in RMB million only (Liangjiang 2,452.0; Bishan 729; Hefei 2,250; Kunming 1,350) and is kept in properties[]._acquired_value_rmb_million; no SGD acquisition cost is disclosed so purchase_price (SGD) left null.
